subject: PERFORM statement
notes: kb/Work/PB438.md - GR18 prints two consecutive sentences naming different destinations after imperative-statement-3 ('control is passed to the end of the PERFORM statement or, if WHEN COMMON is specified, to imperative-statement-4' and 'control is passed as indicated in General rule 14.9.29 or, if WHEN COMMON is specified, to imperative-statement-4'), both on the printed page (PDF page 719), so the duplication and the clause-for-rule cross-reference (14.9.29 is the RAISE statement) are the standard's. DETERMINATION (docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 3, 'where control goes after WHEN OTHER's imperative-statement-3'): the second sentence, read as General rule 20, because GR20 itself says 'the processing in General rules 17, 18, and 19 is completed, return depends on whether the exception condition was fatal or nonfatal' (it names GR18), because with WHEN COMMON both sentences hand control to imperative-statement-4 and GR19 then passes it 'as indicated in General rule 20' (so the first sentence alone would make WHEN OTHER's destination depend on an unrelated phrase), and because a named condition (GR17, returning by GR20) would otherwise resume in place where an unnamed one (WHEN OTHER) abandons imperative-statement-1. The earlier PHASE-13 scout note that the first sentence gives the correct destination is superseded. The compiler already implemented this reading: the WHEN OTHER arm rides the same __RunF3 return path as a named WHEN, so a nonfatal condition resumes in place after the raiser (with or without WHEN COMMON) and a fatal one terminates (14.6.13.1.3). Now witnessed WITHOUT a RESUME in the handler (a RESUME prints the same under both sentences): WhenOther_NonfatalWithoutResume_ContinuesInPlace (OTHER/AFTER/DONE), WhenOther_NonfatalWithCommon_RunsCommonThenContinues (OTHER/COMMON/AFTER/DONE), WhenOther_Fatal_ThenTerminates, WhenOther_ResumeNext_SkipsWhenCommon, the method-scope mirror, and the 2023 golden pb438_f3_when_other_nonfatal_resumes_in_place with its below-2023 refusal (COBOL0900). Probed on the Debug build: EC-USER-DEMO under WHEN OTHER prints OTHER/AFTER/DONE; a fatal EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT under WHEN OTHER prints OTHER then abnormal run-unit termination. retired-witness: conformance-test:PerformFormat3BehaviorTests.WhenOther_HandlesUnnamedCondition (the test wrote RESUME NEXT STATEMENT inside the WHEN OTHER, which prints the same output under both of GR18's two sentences, so it witnessed neither; replaced by WhenOther_NonfatalWithoutResume_ContinuesInPlace and its siblings (kb/Work PB438))
